title: Labor University/Cultural Foundation employees sit in over unpaid wages and request a change of institutional affiliation
participants_original: 700–1,500 attendees estimated by two managers for the 11 Oct gathering
threshold_50_evidence: Two contemporaneous witnesses quoted by Mada Masr estimate 700–1,500 attendees at the single Oct 11 sit-in; nationwide employee count is kept separate.

start_date.summary: Mada Masr says the sit-in started Oct 5.

location.summary: At the Cultural Foundation headquarters in Cairo.

demands.summary: Unpaid September salary and transfer from General Federation of Egyptian Trade Unions to another authority; employee sources appeal to President Sisi.

participants.summary: Two managers estimate 700–1,500 attendees at the Oct 11 gathering; not the organization-wide 3,500–4,000 employees.

state_target.summary: Workers addressed letters to Presidency, Cabinet and official authorities and asked President Sisi to transfer their affiliation.

state_response.summary: Article reports no notification back from official offices by Oct 11; coding as ignore remains provisional and subject to reviewer.

notes: The article dates the sit-in start to Oct 5. Earlier late-September letters and prior-week vigils are not assumed to be the same event start. Employees appeal to the President, Cabinet and official agencies; follow-up and exact end date remain unknown.

title: Unresolved multi-site reports of labor protests against the draft unified HR regulation
participants_original: No per-gathering count; Al Jazeera describes multiple unions and insurance-sector employees
threshold_50_evidence: Sources report multiple union and company actions, but do not provide counts or participant totals at each separate gathering.

start_date.summary: Mubasher dates the actions to Oct 12.

location.summary: Several Egyptian unions and insurance-sector company groups are named broadly; no site list supports a unique gathering.

demands.summary: Opposition to a Ministry of Public Business Sector draft unified human-resources regulation; state policy target is identifiable.

participants.summary: No per-event attendance count; nationwide workforce total cannot be substituted.

threshold_50.summary: Cannot assign 50+ to any one gathering from current bodies.

notes: Keep separate from the Oct 5 Labor University sit-in unless a source establishes a common event. National employee counts are not protest attendance. Location, number of gatherings and threshold per gathering remain unknown.
